instruction: Candid full-shot outdoor photograph of a sunny grassy lawn. The young girl in a white cardigan (R1) leans back dynamically, laughing as she pulls a thick rope with both hands. Behind her, the man in a brown sweater (R2) stands upright and laughs heartily, holding the rope behind her to assist. The background shows a soft-focus grassy field with trees. Bright natural daylight fills the scene, casting soft shadows on the grass and creating a warm, cheerful atmosphere.
